title: The risks agriculture faces in developing countries

sentences.en: A. Two things distinguish food production from all other productive activities: first, every single person needs food each day and has a right to it; and second, it is hugely dependent on nature.
sentences.zh: A. 粮食生产与所有其他生产活动的区别有两点：首先,每个人每天都需要食物并有权获得食物；其次,它极大地依赖于自然。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These two unique aspects, one political, the other natural, make food production highly vulnerable and different from any other business.
sentences.zh: 这两个独特的方面,一个是政治的,另一个是自然的,使得粮食生产非常脆弱,并且与任何其他行业不同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: At the same time, cultural values are highly entrenched in food and.
sentences.zh: 同时,文化价值观在食物和文化中根深蒂固。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: agricultural systems worldwide.
sentences.zh: 全球农业系统。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B. Farmers everywhere face major risks, including extreme weather, long-term climate change, and price volatility in input and product markets.
sentences.zh: B. 世界各地的农民都面临着重大风险,包括极端天气、长期气候变化以及投入品和产品市场的价格波动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: However, smallholder farmers in developing countries must in addition deal with adverse environments, both natural, in terms of soil quality, rainfall, etc., and human, in terms of infrastructure, financial systems, markets, knowledge and technology.
sentences.zh: 然而,发展中国家的小农还必须应对不利的环境,包括土壤质量、降雨等方面的自然环境,以及基础设施、金融体系、市场、知识和技术方面的人为环境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Counter-intuitively, hunger is prevalent among many smallholder farmers in the developing world.
sentences.zh: 与直觉相反,饥饿在发展中国家的许多小农中普遍存在。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. Participants in the online debate argued that our biggest challenge is to address the underlying causes of the agricultural system's inability to ensure sufficient food for all, and they identified as drivers of this problem our dependency on fossil fuels and unsupportive government policies.
sentences.zh: C. 在线辩论的参与者认为,我们最大的挑战是解决农业系统无法确保所有人获得充足食物的根本原因,他们认为导致这一问题的因素是我们对化石燃料的依赖和不支持的政府政策。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D. On the question of mitigating the risks farmers face, most essayists called for greater state intervention.
sentences.zh: D. 在减轻农民面临的风险问题上,大多数散文家呼吁加大国家干预力度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In his essay, Kanayo F. Nwanze, President of the International Fund for Agricultural Development, argued that governments can significantly reduce risks for farmers by providing basic services like roads to get produce more efficiently to markets, or water and food storage facilities to reduce losses.
sentences.zh: 国际农业发展基金会主席卡纳约·F·恩万泽 (Kanayo F. Nwanze) 在他的文章中认为,政府可以通过提供基本服务（例如道路）以更有效地将农产品运往市场,或提供水和食品储存设施来减少损失,从而显着降低农民的风险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sophia Murphy, senior advisor to the Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy, suggested that the procurement and holding of stocks by governments can also help mitigate wild swings in food prices by alleviating uncertainties about market supply.
sentences.zh: 农业与贸易政策研究所高级顾问索菲亚·墨菲表示,政府采购和持有库存还可以通过减轻市场供应的不确定性来帮助缓解粮食价格的剧烈波动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: *The personal names in the text refer to the authors of written contributions to the online debate.
sentences.zh: *文中的个人姓名指的是在线辩论的书面贡献的作者。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E. Shenggen Fan, Director General of the International Food Policy Research Institute, held up social safety nets and public welfare programmes in Ethiopia, Brazil and Mexico as valuable ways to address poverty among farming families and reduce their vulnerability to agriculture shocks.
sentences.zh: 国际粮食政策研究所所长范胜根认为,埃塞俄比亚、巴西和墨西哥的社会安全网和公共福利计划是解决农业家庭贫困问题和减少其对农业冲击脆弱性的宝贵途径。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, some commentators responded that cash transfers to poor families do not necessarily translate into increased food security, as these programmes do not always strengthen food production or raise incomes.
sentences.zh: 然而,一些评论员回应说,向贫困家庭提供现金转移不一定会提高粮食安全,因为这些计划并不总是能加强粮食生产或提高收入。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Regarding state subsidies for agriculture, Rokeya Kabir, Executive Director of Bangladesh Nari Progati Sangha, commented in her essay that these 'have not compensated for the stranglehold exercised by private traders.
sentences.zh: 关于国家对农业的补贴,孟加拉国 Nari Progati Sangha 执行董事 Rokeya Kabir 在她的文章中评论说,这些补贴“并没有弥补私人贸易商的束缚”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In fact, studies show that sixty percent of beneficiaries of subsidies are not poor, but rich landowners and non-farmer traders. "
sentences.zh: 事实上,研究表明,百分之六十的补贴受益者不是穷人,而是富裕的地主和非农商人。 ”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F. Nwanze, Murphy and Fan argued that private risk management tools, like private insurance, commodity futures markets, and rural finance can help small-scale producers mitigate risk and allow for investment in improvements.
sentences.zh: F. Nwanze、Murphy 和 Fan 认为,私人风险管理工具,如私人保险、商品期货市场和农村金融,可以帮助小规模生产者减轻风险,并允许投资进行改进。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Kabir warned that financial support schemes often encourage the adoption of high-input agricultural practices, which in the medium term may raise production costs beyond the value of their harvests.
sentences.zh: 卡比尔警告说,财政支持计划往往鼓励采用高投入的农业实践,从中期来看,这可能会导致生产成本超出其收成的价值。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Murphy noted that when futures markets become excessively financialised they can contribute to short-term price volatility, which increases farmers' food insecurity.
sentences.zh: 墨菲指出,当期货市场过度金融化时,可能会导致短期价格波动,从而加剧农民的粮食不安全。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Many participants and commentators emphasised that greater transparency in markets is needed to mitigate the impact of volatility, and make evident whether adequate stocks and supplies are available.
sentences.zh: 许多参与者和评论员强调,需要提高市场透明度,以减轻波动的影响,并明确是否有足够的库存和供应。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Others contended that agribusiness companies should be held responsible for paying for negative side effects.
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为农业综合企业应该为负面影响买单。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: G. Many essayists mentioned climate change and its consequences for small-scale agriculture.
sentences.zh: G. 许多散文家提到了气候变化及其对小规模农业的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fan explained that 'in addition to reducing crop yields, climate change increases the magnitude and the frequency of extreme weather events, which increase smallholder vulnerability. The growing unpredictability of weather patterns increases farmers' difficulty in managing weather-related risks.
sentences.zh: 范解释说,“除了减少农作物产量外,气候变化还增加了极端天气事件的强度和频率,从而增加了小农的脆弱性。天气模式越来越不可预测,增加了农民管理天气相关风险的难度。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: According to this author, one solution would be to develop crop varieties that are more resilient to new climate trends and extreme weather patterns.
sentences.zh: 根据该作者的说法,一种解决方案是开发更能适应新气候趋势和极端天气模式的作物品种。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Accordingly, Pat Mooney, co-founder and executive director of the ETC Group, suggested that if we are to survive climate change, we must adopt policies that let peasants diversify the plant and animal species and varieties/breeds that make up our menus. "
sentences.zh: 因此,ETC 集团联合创始人兼执行董事帕特·穆尼 (Pat Mooney) 建议,如果我们要应对气候变化,就必须采取政策,让农民实现菜单中动植物物种和品种的多样化。 ”

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: H. Some participating authors and commentators argued in favour of community based and autonomous risk management strategies through collective action groups, co-operatives or producers' groups.
sentences.zh: H. 一些参与作者和评论员主张通过集体行动团体、合作社或生产者团体采取基于社区的自主风险管理策略。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such groups enhance market opportunities for small-scale producers, reduce marketing costs and synchronise buying and selling with seasonal price conditions.
sentences.zh: 这些团体增加了小规模生产者的市场机会,降低了营销成本,并使买卖与季节性价格条件同步。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: According to Murphy, 'collective action offers an important way for farmers to strengthen their political and economic bargaining power, and to reduce their business risks.’ One commentator, Giel Ton, warned that collective action does not come as a free good. It takes time, effort and money to organise, build trust and to experiment. Others, like Marcel Vernooij and Marcel Beukeboom, suggested that in order to 'apply what we already know', all stakeholders, including business, government, scientists and civil society, must work together, starting at the beginning of the value chain.
sentences.zh: 墨菲认为,“集体行动为农民提供了增强政治和经济议价能力、降低商业风险的重要途径。”一位评论员吉尔·托恩警告说,集体行动并不是免费的。组织、建立信任和试验需要时间、精力和金钱。 Marcel Vernooij 和 Marcel Beukeboom 等其他人建议,为了“应用我们已知的知识”,所有利益相关者,包括企业、政府、科学家和民间社会,必须从价值链的起点开始共同努力。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: I. Some participants explained that market price volatility is often worsened by the presence of intermediary purchasers who, taking advantage of farmers' vulnerability, dictate prices.
sentences.zh: I. 一些与会者解释说,中间购买者的存在往往会加剧市场价格波动,这些中间购买者利用农民的脆弱性来决定价格。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: One commentator suggested farmers can gain greater control over prices and minimise price volatility by selling directly to consumers.
sentences.zh: 一位评论员建议农民可以通过直接向消费者销售来更好地控制价格并最大限度地减少价格波动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Similarly, Sonali Bisht, founder and advisor to the Institute of Himalayan Environmental Research and Education (INHERE), India, wrote that community-supported agriculture, where consumers invest in local farmers by subscription and guarantee producers a fair price, is a risk-sharing model worth more attention.
sentences.zh: 同样,印度喜马拉雅环境研究与教育研究所（INHERE）创始人兼顾问索纳利·比什特（Sonali Bisht）写道,社区支持农业是一种值得更多关注的风险分担模式,即消费者通过认购方式向当地农民投资,并保证生产者获得公平的价格。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Direct food distribution systems not only encourage small-scale agriculture but also give consumers more control over the food they consume, she wrote.
sentences.zh: 直接食品分配系统不仅鼓励小规模农业,而且使消费者能够更好地控制他们消费的食品,她写道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
